definitions.explanation: Ordinary clothes as opposed to formal wear, uniforms, or mourning dress. Mostly met in invitations and notices.

examples.japanese: {平服|へいふく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{越|こ}し→お越し：07322_okoshi⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{案内状|あんないじょう}→案内状：19683_annaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{平服|へいふく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧。

{平服|へいふく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦ジーンズ→ジーンズ：00123_jiinzu⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いた→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無難|ぶなん}→無難：15801_bunan⟧だ。
examples.english: Even when told "informal dress," it's safest to wear a sober suit rather than jeans.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
In an invitation, {平服|へいふく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{越|こ}し→お越し：07322_okoshi⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ does not mean casual clothes. It means "no formal wear needed": a suit or a smart dress. At a memorial service it means subdued, dark clothes rather than full mourning dress.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平服|へいふく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to attend in informal dress
- {平服|へいふく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧: to change into ordinary clothes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{普段着|ふだんぎ}→普段着：15346_fudangi⟧: everyday clothes worn at home or around town (more casual)
- ⟦{礼服|れいふく}→礼服：18440_reifuku⟧: formal wear, the opposite of {平服|へいふく}
